name: Moonlit Crystal Fjord
description: A narrow fjord flanked by towering crystal cliffs that reflect the moon, creating an infinite corridor of shimmering light.

caption: Walk the mirror path to the moon. 🌙💎 #MoonlitCrystalFjord
